name: Hekayatna
source:
A visual novel based on Libyan Arab folklore, featuring tales:

Aunt Ghoulah – Ahmad visits his aunt’s village and uncovers strange happenings linked to a mysterious old neighbor.

Um Bsisi – Pinky, a curious little mouse, is sent on a simple errand that turns into an unexpected adventure.

[From [url=https://moadalhmre.itch.io/hekayatna]Itch.io[/url]]
